content.text:
I fixed the version dropdown getting stuck when the `current` version's path is `/`. The 44 existing client tests in the docs plugin still pass. I didn't add a test for this case, and I didn't run a site to check the dropdown by eye.

**Cause:** the code that works out which docs version you're on (`getActiveVersion` in `packages/docusaurus-plugin-content-docs/src/client/docsClientUtils.ts`) checked the versions in a fixed order, putting only the latest version last. That order assumed the latest version was the one with the catch-all path (`/docs/`). In the issue's setup, `current` has that path but isn't the latest version, so it was checked before `v0.1.2`. Its path matches every docs page, so the dropdown always showed "Current".

**Fix:** before matching, the versions are now sorted by path length, longest first. A catch-all path is always shorter than the paths under it, so it is checked last whichever version owns it. When two paths are the same length, the original order is kept.
